CREATE INDEX artworks_atlas_illustrated_identity_idx ON public.artworks USING btree (id) INCLUDE (creation_year_start, creation_year_end, primary_media_id, work_type, cultural_context) WHERE ((status <> 'archived'::text) AND (primary_media_id IS NOT NULL) AND (date_precision = ANY (ARRAY['exact'::text, 'circa'::text, 'range'::text, 'circa_range'::text, 'decade'::text, 'century'::text])) AND (artline_creation_scope(creation_year_start, creation_year_end, date_precision) = 'eligible'::text) AND (COALESCE(creation_year_start, creation_year_end) <> 0) AND (COALESCE(creation_year_end, creation_year_start) <> 0))

CREATE INDEX artworks_atlas_illustrated_native_idx ON public.artworks USING btree (COALESCE(creation_year_start, creation_year_end), id) INCLUDE (creation_year_start, creation_year_end, status, date_precision, primary_media_id, work_type, cultural_context) WHERE ((status <> 'archived'::text) AND (primary_media_id IS NOT NULL) AND (date_precision = ANY (ARRAY['exact'::text, 'circa'::text, 'range'::text, 'circa_range'::text, 'decade'::text, 'century'::text])) AND (artline_creation_scope(creation_year_start, creation_year_end, date_precision) = 'eligible'::text) AND (COALESCE(creation_year_start, creation_year_end) <> 0) AND (COALESCE(creation_year_end, creation_year_start) <> 0))
